audience: domain owners and system administrators who manage DNS zones, records and monitoring in ClouDNS

useCases.title: List the DNS zones of an account
useCases.text: List the zones, or the zones whose name matches a keyword. Open one zone to see its status and whether it is a master or slave zone.

useCases.title: Read the TXT records on one host
useCases.text: List the records of a zone for one host, such as _dmarc, or for one record type. Use host_like to match part of a host name. The tool reads master zones only.

useCases.title: Add a domain verification TXT record
useCases.text: List the TXT records first to check that the record is not there. Then add the verification record to a master zone. This changes live DNS, and a repeat call adds a duplicate.

useCases.title: Check failover and monitoring status
useCases.text: List the monitoring checks to see which are down or paused. Read the failover settings of one record to see whether its failover is active.
